name: clearchat
description: ClearChat — chat desktop minimalista para qualquer endpoint OpenAI-compatible
author: Eduardo Zenere

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:unit: node --import ./e2e/ts-hooks.mjs --test e2e/unit.test.ts e2e/markdown.test.ts e2e/attachments.test.ts e2e/models.test.ts e2e/smartApprove.test.ts e2e/approvalSafety.test.ts e2e/contextCapture.test.ts e2e/processes.test.ts e2e/adapters.test.ts e2e/askUser.test.ts e2e/readMedia.test.ts e2e/approvals.test.ts e2e/webSearch.test.ts e2e/searchEngines.test.ts e2e/modelParams.test.ts e2e/networkRetry.test.ts e2e/approvalQueue.test.ts e2e/dates.test.ts e2e/historySearch.test.ts e2e/memory.test.ts e2e/memoryUi.test.ts e2e/skills.test.ts e2e/syncCrypto.test.ts e2e/syncFakeServer.test.ts e2e/syncEngine.test.ts e2e/updates.test.ts e2e/branches.test.ts e2e/branchingRunner.test.ts e2e/siblingMessages.test.ts e2e/branchView.test.ts e2e/presentFile.test.ts e2e/remoteFiles.test.ts e2e/fileActions.test.ts e2e/toolOutputs.test.ts e2e/pageExtract.test.ts e2e/autoTitle.test.ts e2e/chatUi.test.ts e2e/sideReasoning.test.ts e2e/sideCache.test.ts e2e/modelCompat.test.ts e2e/voice.test.ts e2e/stt.test.ts
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:dir: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:all: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb pacman tar.gz --x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64
